name: Defold
description: Editor auto-updates hourly; the sha1 field is only a URL version-tag, downloaded ZIP hash never verified.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Defold’s editor schedules hourly update checks and uses the server’s sha1 field as a release identifier in its update state. This does not establish that the field is an artifact digest or independently authenticated publisher metadata.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; server-side manifest controls, transport configuration beyond the URL templates, and shipped artifact behavior were not independently audited.

original_evidence.text: | Defold (Editor 2 self-updater) | github.com/defold/defold | Clojure/JVM desktop editor | Y | Y (hourly timer: `initial-update-delay 1000`, `update-delay 3600000` ms, started at editor launch via `start!`) | Y (downloads ZIP bundle of new editor build, extracts, sets executable bit on binaries, replaces install-dir contents, restarts) | HTTPS (`connection-properties` `:updater` URL templates all `https://%s/...`; `archive-domain` e.g. d.defold.com) | N | **none** — the `sha1` returned by the update-check JSON is used only as a version-id embedded in the download URL and as a local "have we downloaded this" marker file; the downloaded ZIP's actual hash is never recomputed/compared after download | n/a | editor/src/clj/editor/updater.clj `check!` (fetches `update-url` JSON, reads `:sha1`); `extract!` (`(spit update-sha1-file server-sha1)` — writes the server-supplied id without ever hashing `zip-file` for comparison); `(.setExecutable target-file true)` in `extract!`; editor/src/clj/editor/connection_properties.clj:24-27 (`https://%s/archive/%s/%s/editor2/Defold-%s.zip`, `https://%s/editor2/channels/%s/update-v4.json`) |
